items.text: OpenAI published an engineering deep dive on rebuilding its voice stack for GPT-Live, routing audio down a fast path and cutting session startup from six network round trips.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 发布工程详解，介绍如何为 GPT-Live 重构语音栈：音频走专用快速通道，推理与工具调用异步进行，语音会话启动从六次网络往返大幅压缩。

items.text: Microsoft Research open-sourced Orchard, a Kubernetes-based framework for training and evaluating agents, with its 3B-active-parameter Orchard-SWE hitting 69.7% on SWE-bench Verified.
items.text_zh: 微软研究院开源 Orchard 智能体训练与评测框架，基于轻量 Kubernetes 环境；其约 30 亿激活参数的 Orchard-SWE 在 SWE-bench Verified 上取得 69.7%。

items.text: Vercel launched the v0 API, giving developers programmatic app building: start a chat from a prompt, repo or ZIP, and render a dev-server preview.
items.text_zh: Vercel 推出 v0 API，开发者可通过编程方式调用其应用生成能力：从提示词、代码仓库或 ZIP 发起会话，并渲染开发服务器预览。

items.text: SenseTime open-sourced SenseNova U1.5-Lite-Preview, an 8B unified multimodal model that generates native 4K images and supports pixel-level editing, released on GitHub, Hugging Face and ModelScope.
items.text_zh: 商汤开源 SenseNova U1.5-Lite-Preview，8B 原生统一多模态模型，支持 4K 直出图像生成与像素级编辑，已上线 GitHub、Hugging Face 与魔搭。

items.text: The team behind Design Arena raised a $7.9 million seed led by Index Ventures to rank media-generating AI models on human taste judgments.
items.text_zh: Design Arena 团队完成 790 万美元种子轮融资，由 Index Ventures 领投，Conviction、A* 等跟投，以人类偏好对生成类 AI 模型的"审美"排名。

items.text: Cognition hired former Coinbase chief legal officer Paul Grewal, who stepped down on July 31, as its chief legal and global affairs officer.
items.text_zh: Devin 开发商 Cognition 宣布聘请前 Coinbase 首席法务官 Paul Grewal 出任首席法务与全球事务官，其于 7 月 31 日刚从 Coinbase 卸任。

items.text: ElevenLabs launched ElevenAgents for enterprises, saying over 10 million voice and chat agent conversations already run on the platform weekly with configurable guardrails and regional data residency.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 推出面向企业的 ElevenAgents，称平台每周已承载超过 1000 万次语音与文字客服对话，提供可配置护栏与区域数据驻留选项。

items.text: Meshy rolled out 8K texturing for its 3D generation platform, showcasing worn metal, plush and plastic materials rendered at production fidelity.
items.text_zh: 3D 生成平台 Meshy 上线 8K 贴图能力，展示做旧金属、绒布与塑料等材质的高保真渲染效果，向"可直接使用"的资产质量靠拢。

items.text: Kuaishou's Kling published a Kling MCP tutorial showing agents batch-producing food promo videos, from analyzing creative styles and building storyboards to generating final shots.
items.text_zh: 快手可灵发布 Kling MCP 教程，演示智能体批量生产美食推广视频：从分析创意风格、生成分镜脚本到成片输出全流程自动化。

items.text: Xiaoda Robotics and NTU's S-Lab open-sourced ACE-Data-0, an embodied dataset of 17 million frames across 200 task categories recorded in two real homes.
items.text_zh: 大晓机器人联合南洋理工 S-Lab 开源具身数据集 ACE-Data-0：1700 万帧视频、200 个任务类别，取自两个真实家庭环境，同步七种模态信号。

items.text: Interpol said AI has become the core operational driver of cybercrime across Africa, powering scams, fraud and impersonation at growing scale.
items.text_zh: 国际刑警组织表示，AI 已成为非洲网络犯罪的"核心运营驱动力"，被广泛用于诈骗、欺诈与身份冒充，规模持续扩大。

items.text: A US company's AI now lets Ukraine's low-cost kamikaze drones track targets autonomously, a step toward future swarm attacks.
items.text_zh: 一家美国公司的 AI 让乌克兰廉价自杀式无人机具备自主跟踪目标能力，被视为迈向未来蜂群攻击的一步。

items.text: An AI-supervised remote exam failed so badly that 58,000 students have been ordered to retake it, renewing scrutiny of automated proctoring.
items.text_zh: 一场由 AI 监考的远程考试出现严重故障，5.8 万名学生被要求重考，自动化监考技术的可靠性再度受到质疑。

items.text: MarkTechPost published a hands-on guide to evaluating multimodal vision models with Moonshot's PerceptionBench, using robust data loading and automated LLM judging.
items.text_zh: MarkTechPost 发布实操教程，讲解如何用月之暗面的 PerceptionBench 评测多模态视觉模型，涵盖稳健的数据加载与自动化裁判评分流程。
